files.content:
# Pixel Library Desk

A responsive, offline browser app that displays 6 built-in books with availability status. Users can check out and return books, filter to show only available books, and see a count of checked-out books.

## Features

- List of 6 books with title, author, and status (Available / Checked out)
- Buttons to check out or return each book
- Filter checkbox to show only available books
- Live count of checked-out books
- Keyboard accessible controls with proper labels
- Responsive layout down to 360px width
- Cohesive color palette and polished UI

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## File Structure

- `index.html` – main HTML structure
- `styles.css` – styling and theming
- `app.js` – book data, rendering, and interactions
- `README.md` – this file

## Technologies

- HTML5
- CSS3 (system fonts, flexbox, responsive)
- Plain JavaScript (no frameworks, no dependencies)

## Accessibility

- All controls are keyboard accessible
- ARIA labels on buttons for screen readers
- Live region for checked-out count
- Visible focus states
